attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across the 3-node Alpine cluster: node1 is the writable primary, node2 and node3 are read-only standbys built via pg_basebackup with a dedicated scram-sha-256 'replicator' role. Verified writes on node1 propagate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Performed the mandatory sequential restart protocol (baseline -> reboot -> boot_id change proof -> recovery/replication proof) on all three nodes, one at a time, preserving the primary/standby topology and data integrity throughout.
